steps.title: Отметь, чему научился
items: ✓ use everyday work words — interrupt, in charge, slip out, wages, confirm
✓ announce a change — There’s been a change of plan
✓ give a reason that shows the plan can move — I’m supposed to be…ing
✓ suggest a new time — How about…ing? / Would it be possible to…?
✓ turn a time down politely — I’m really sorry, but I can’t make it then
✓ write a professional email with one apology and the right sign-off
